description: Canonical registry of all force‑regime operators in TriadicFrameworks MCP. Each operator includes category, definition, semantics, and impact profile.

operators.name: push
operators.definition: Applies outward gradient pressure across a force‑regime surface.
operators.impactProfile: Increases gradient intensity; used to amplify unseen force transitions.

operators.name: pull
operators.definition: Applies inward gradient contraction across a force‑regime surface.
operators.impactProfile: Decreases gradient intensity; used to stabilize or collapse force transitions.

operators.name: bind
operators.definition: Creates coherence bonds between force‑regime surfaces.
operators.impactProfile: Increases coherence and structural integrity across unseen force fields.

operators.name: gradient
operators.impactProfile: Controls slope and intensity of unseen force gradients.

operators.name: fieldShift
operators.impactProfile: Reorients unseen force fields; used for coherence realignment.

operators.name: ruptureForce
operators.impactProfile: Creates discontinuities; used to model rupture, breakage, or instability.
